title: Mail Send Operation Authorization

items.action: view mail send operation history and details
send test mail and retry mail send operations
enter the Email Accounts UI and discover existing accounts used for test mail
update email account configuration only; does not authorize sending mail

database.reason: Fair CRM product persistence is unchanged; the companion Core migration adds only permission catalog/group rows and preserves existing role access.

notes: Mail operation history is owned by fair_crm.mail_send_operations.read. Any mail-send side effect covered by this maintenance change, including email-account test sends and operation retry, requires fair_crm.mail_send_operations.execute. The test-send backend mutation boundary remains execute-only and is enforced before account lookup. In the frontend, /admin/email-accounts additionally requires fair_crm.email_accounts.read so the user can enter the page and discover/select an existing account; a user with email_accounts.read plus mail_send_operations.execute but without email_accounts.update receives test-mail controls without configuration mutation controls. fair_crm.email_accounts.update remains limited to account configuration changes. The Fair CRM development/CI role matrix is synchronized to the dedicated read/execute permissions while preserving existing OrganizationAdmin access. The companion Core migration introduces the dedicated read/execute permissions and copies existing email-account read/update role state to preserve access during the semantic split. Prod-path E2E resolves a same-named kyrox-core branch when present, otherwise falls back to main, so cross-repository permission migrations are tested against the matching Fair CRM change without changing independent PR behavior.
